points.quote: deploying generative AI without proper acknowledgement constitutes Unfair Practice and will result in your work being penalised under Section 10: Academic Integrity of LBU’s Academic Regulations.
points.gist: Using generative AI without proper acknowledgement is Unfair Practice and results in work being penalised under Section 10 of the Academic Regulations.

points.quote: Any paraphrases or summaries created by AI need to be treated as direct quotations (with secondary referencing) in your work.
points.gist: AI-created paraphrases or summaries must be treated as direct quotations with secondary referencing.

points.quote: Do not enter sensitive, personal, or protected information into AI tools
points.gist: Do not enter sensitive, personal or protected information into AI tools.

points.quote: assignments, exams, seminars and lecture slides, which are the Intellectual Property of the University or others
points.gist: Assignments, exams, seminars and lecture slides are the Intellectual Property of the University or others.

points.quote: we have also introduced the Turnitin AI detection tool in the Academic Year 2023/24 so that any unacknowledged use of this learning resource can be detected.
points.gist: The Turnitin AI detection tool was introduced in 2023/24 so unacknowledged use can be detected.

points.quote: we will ask you to make a statement explaining your use of generative AI and acknowledging how it was used.
points.gist: Students will be asked to make a statement explaining and acknowledging their use of generative AI.

points.quote: This is currently being piloted and will be implemented across the University from the 2024/25 academic year.
points.gist: The statement is being piloted and will be implemented university-wide from 2024/25.

points.quote: It remains your responsibility to critically assess the output and cross-check the information with reputable sources.
points.gist: Students remain responsible for critically assessing output and cross-checking it with reputable sources.

points.quote: Avoid depending on generative AI tools for critical thinking and remember these tools are not search engines.
points.gist: Avoid depending on generative AI for critical thinking, and remember the tools are not search engines.
AI tools can perpetuate biases and stereotypes.

points.quote: Receive advice on enhancing your writing abilities, covering areas like grammar and structure (e.g., "Provide feedback on how I can improve the writing style in the following paragraph").
points.anchor: How can LBU students use generative AI in their studies?
points.gist: Using AI for advice on improving writing, such as grammar and structure, is given as a way to make the most of it.

points.quote: Be aware that phrases and concepts produced by certain generative AI tools may incorporate ideas from other human authors without proper referencing, potentially constituting plagiarism.
points.anchor: How can LBU students use generative AI in their studies?
points.gist: AI-produced phrases and concepts may incorporate other authors' ideas without referencing, potentially constituting plagiarism.

points.quote: We will also consider a review of our grading criteria
points.gist: The university will consider a review of its grading criteria.

points.gist: An LBU Academic Integrity Tutorial is available on MyBeckett.
